# Combobox

A text field with an async suggestion list. The list drops in 8px below the field. Arrow keys move, Enter chooses, Escape or leaving the field closes. When lookups overlap, only the latest answer is shown.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/combobox)

## Usage

```tsx
<Combobox
  label="City"
  value={text}
  onChange={setText}
  search={query => fetch('/cities?q=' + query).then(r => r.json())}
  renderOption={city => <><strong>{city.name}</strong>, {city.country}</>}
  onSelect={city => setText(city.name)}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | Placeholder while empty, small label once filled. |
| `value / onChange` | `string / (value) => void` | The typed text. |
| `search` | `(query) => Promise<T[]>` | Looks up suggestions. Resolve to [] to show none. |
| `renderOption` | `(option) => ReactNode` | One row. &lt;strong> parts are black; the rest is grey. |
| `onSelect` | `(option) => void` | A suggestion was chosen. |
| `minChars` | `number` | Characters to type before the first lookup. Default 3. |
| `heading, closeLabel, listLabel` | `string` | Wording of the list’s heading and accessible names. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Combobox.module.css`
- `Combobox.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/hooks/useSuggestions.ts`](../../hooks/useSuggestions.ts)
- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/primitives/Field`](../Field)
- [`src/primitives/FieldError`](../FieldError)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
